title: Test Generation, Severity & Fix-Loop Policy
source: Non-Tech Change Management with AI Assistance Playbook — testing before go-live (extends generate-test-scenarios)
severityNote: Severity derives deterministically from the scenario Category and is recorded per scenario for auditability. Changes to the mapping are made by editing this policy file, never ad hoc in a dossier.

testTypeExpectations.note: Happy-path behavior asserted at the unit level; add integration when the flow crosses a module or process boundary.

conditional.if: the covered flow is latency/throughput-sensitive or DESIGN.md flags a hot path

testTypes.unit: Asserts one function/module in isolation with local fixtures/mocks.
testTypes.integration: Asserts a flow across modules/routes using the project's own runner; external systems mocked or containerized locally.
testTypes.security: Asserts auth/access boundaries, input validation, and never-log.json data handling for the covered code.
testTypes.performance: Asserts a stated latency/throughput budget locally; never a load test against a live system.

runPolicy.auto: Generated test-code suites that are hermetic — run by the project's own test runner, against local fixtures/mocks/containers, touching no live or external system and mutating no shared state — run automatically, without asking.
runPolicy.ask: Any check that touches a live or external system, mutates shared state, or requires manual steps runs only after the user's explicit go-ahead (the pre-v2 behavior, preserved for exactly this class).
hermeticTest: invoked via the project's own runner (package.json test script or the runner it declares)
no network calls to live/external endpoints (mocks, fakes, or local containers only)
no writes outside the repo/test sandbox

procedure: diagnose root cause (reproduce, isolate — no fix before the cause is understood)
apply the minimal fix to the correct side
re-run the finding's tests plus any suite whose freshness set intersects the changed files
fixLoop.onExhausted: Record FAILED (<date>, <root-cause note>, NEEDS-HUMAN) and stop looping. The finding still blocks the gate per golive-gate.json test-scenario-complete — NEEDS-HUMAN routes it to a person, it never waives it.
fixLoop.mediumLowPolicy: Medium/Low failures are never auto-looped: present one compact batch ask (TS-ID, title, severity, one-line failure) and run the same bounded loop only for the findings the user selects; unselected findings stay FAILED, recorded honestly.

qualityRules: Never add assertion-free tests to lift counts or coverage — every generated test asserts observable behavior.
Never weaken, delete, or skip a failing assertion to make a run pass — a product bug is fixed in product code, a test bug in test code.
Never fabricate a PASSED result — a test that cannot run is PENDING or FAILED, never PASSED.

Use only the approved test tooling from allowedStack in build-contract.json (bun test for unit/integration, Playwright for browser journeys); tech-radar only for gaps it does not cover; place test files per code-structure conventions; never introduce a new framework when the project already has one.
